Stored Results/Preview identity contains path strings only, so the opened replacement is not compared with the searched root inode/device. A new recovery filename can be created outside the selected repository. Exclusive final name creation preserves existing files but does not preserve destination ownership. Windows initial root similarly follows the root and needs stable opened-directory identity.
